title: VTG-GPT: Tuning-Free Zero-Shot Video Temporal Grounding with GPT

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: To tackle these challenges, we propose VTG-GPT, a GPT-based method for zero-shot VTG without training or fine-tuning.

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: VTG-GPT: Tuning-Free Zero-Shot Video Temporal Grounding with GPT Video temporal grounding (VTG) aims to locate specific temporal segments from an untrimmed video based on a linguistic query.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Most existing VTG models are trained on extensive annotated video-text pairs, a process that not only introduces human biases from the queries but also incurs significant computational costs.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: Most existing VTG models are trained on extensive annotated video-text pairs, a process that not only introduces human biases from the queries but also incurs significant computational costs.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: Finally, we devise the proposal generator and post-processing to produce accurate segments from debiased queries and image captions.
